name: Facet
text: Make the timeline strip a single horizontal bar, notched with small vertical ticks for key events. This keeps the playhead’s position instantly visible without cluttering the view. The trade-off is less room for detailed labels, but clarity beats precision here—users can hover for exact times.

name: Pane
text: The single horizontal bar buries critical context when users zoom into dense data—critical details vanish behind the playhead’s fixed position. A collapsible strip with expandable segments preserves visibility at all scales; settle this by testing both against a real dataset where users must identify anomalies at 10x zoom.
